title: Biogenic synthesis and antimicrobial properties of rare-earth element nanoparticles using Moringa oleifera
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36490-36503
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04558D, Paper
Open Access

Nader Anis, Amira A. Gamal, Nada Emam, Mostafa Gomaa Fadl, A. I. L. Abd El Fatah
Multi-rare earth oxide nanoparticles (∼29 nm) were green-synthesized using Moringa oleifera leaf extract. These NPs showed potent, broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity, offering a sustainable alternative against microbial pathogens.
